description: This PHP source file defines the KpiSaveController class within the OrangeHRM Performance module. The class handles pre-render logic for KPI (Key Performance Indicator) editing and saving, dynamically setting component properties for the front-end Vue.js components based on request attributes and KPI default data.

classes.name: KpiSaveController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing KPI save and edit operations, extending from AbstractVueController and utilizing traits for KPI services.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering by setting properties based on whether a KPI ID is provided in the request or default KPI data.
